versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI image generation skill.
- Generate images with 50+ AI models via SkillBoss API Hub, including FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and more.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, image editing, upscaling, LoRA, and text rendering capabilities.
- Provides simple API usage examples for a range of scenarios: quality images, fast generation, aspect ratio control, upscaling, and text rendering.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable for access.
